Metadata.title: Spirit O Santa for Stores
Metadata.description: List gift items for local kids and get paid when they earn them.

HomePage.title: Spirit O Santa for Stores
HomePage.intro: List up to 50 gift items. Kids earn them with good deeds, and you get paid.

RegisterPage.title: List your store on Spirit O Santa
RegisterPage.intro: Local kids earn gifts with good deeds. Sign up, add up to 50 items, and bill us the agreed wholesale cost when an item is earned.
RegisterPage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
RegisterPage.descriptionHint: What do you sell? Families will see this once you're approved.
RegisterPage.sentBody: We've sent a confirmation link. Confirm your email, then sign in to set up your items while we review your store.

StoreAgreement.title: Store discount and guarantee agreement
StoreAgreement.p1: You list items at your normal retail price. Each item's price in magic points equals its retail price in dollars.
StoreAgreement.p2: Spirit O Santa agrees a discount off retail with your store when we approve it. When a child's item is funded, you bill Spirit O Santa the agreed wholesale cost (retail price minus that discount).
StoreAgreement.p3: You guarantee listed items stay available at the listed price for the season, or you offer an equal or better substitute.
StoreAgreement.p4: Spirit O Santa keeps the difference between retail and wholesale to run the program.
StoreAgreement.p5: Spirit O Santa pays your invoices by check or another method outside the app. No bank details are stored in the app.
StoreAgreement.accept: I have read and accept the store discount and guarantee agreement.

AcceptInvitePage.title: Accept your store invitation
AcceptInvitePage.intro: Spirit O Santa has invited {storeName}. Set up your owner account to start listing items.
AcceptInvitePage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
AcceptInvitePage.done: You're all set! Your store is approved and your account is ready.
AcceptInvitePage.invalid: This invitation link has expired or was already used. Ask Spirit O Santa to send a new one.

Dashboard.title: Store dashboard
Dashboard.noAccess: Your account isn't connected to a store right now. If you were removed by the store owner, ask them to invite you again.

statusHelp.pending: We're reviewing your store. You can set up your profile, photos and team now. Families will see your store once it's approved.
statusHelp.invited: Your store invitation hasn't been accepted yet.
statusHelp.approved: Your store is approved and visible to families.
statusHelp.suspended: Your store is suspended and hidden from families. Contact Spirit O Santa to resolve this.

Profile.title: Store profile
Profile.readOnly: Your store's profile can't be edited in its current status.
Profile.noPhotos: No photos yet. Add a photo of your storefront or products.
Profile.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. We remove location data from photos automatically.

Reps.title: Reps
Reps.intro: Reps are your staff. They can manage items and inventory, but only you can change prices, your profile and your team.
Reps.readOnly: Your team can't be changed in your store's current status.
Reps.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? They'll be signed out and lose access to your store.
Reps.inviteIntro: They'll get an email link (valid 7 days) to choose a name and password.
Reps.removed: Rep removed. They've been signed out.
Reps.inviteNeedsApproval: You can invite reps once your store is approved.

AcceptRepInvitePage.done: You're all set! Sign in to start helping with your store's items.
